caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The pitcher has a wide spout, a prominent handle, and a rounded body that narrows at the neck. The top half of the pitcher is a warm, orange-brown color, and it features a decorative relief of a red flower with layered petals on its front surface. Below the flower, there is a horizontal band encircling the pitcher, decorated with a zigzag red-and-green pattern. The lower part of the pitcher is shaded in green, gradually blending into the earthier tones above. The handle is angular and also colored in a similar orange-brown shade. The bottom of the pitcher is a slightly darker green and appears rounded. The drawing is detailed and shaded to give the pitcher a three-dimensional appearance. There is text below the pitcher identifying the artist and drawing reference.
title: Carved Wooden Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
